hexmap: Convert a Map into a Hexagon Tile Map

Source: R/hexmap-package.R
hexmap-package.Rd

Converts a map of regions, as an 'sf' object, into a map of equally sized hexagons with one hexagon for each region. Regions are allocated hexagons by minimising the total squared displacement of all regions, so regions keep their relative positions, while distant islands are tiled separately. Groups of regions (such as states) can be kept together using one of several layouts, including a diffusion cartogram (Gastner and Newman, 2004) doi:10.1073/pnas.0400280101 and spatially ordered treemaps (Wood and Dykes, 2008) doi:10.1109/TVCG.2008.165 . This makes small but important regions as visible as large, sparsely populated ones.
